title: 壁掛け消火ホース収納箱
description: 透明扉越しに連続した巻きホース、リール、ノズルが見える壁掛け収納箱。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Wall-mounted cabinet with glazed framed door, continuous coiled hose, reel, brass nozzle and mounting lugs. Visual prop; not certified emergency equipment. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
